name: image-gen
description: Generates an image from a text prompt, or edits an existing image when given its URL. Uploads the result to a private S3-compatible object store and returns a time-limited presigned URL. One tool covers both create-from-scratch and iterative refinement: pass a prior image's URL back in to keep editing the same picture.
input: A single string: either a JSON object {"prompt": string, "image_url"?: string, "size"?: string, "quality"?: string, "background"?: string}, or a bare prompt string. When image_url is present the tool edits that image; otherwise it generates a new one.
output: Markdown embedding the produced image's presigned URL, plus an ArtifactRef (uri/sha256/bytes/content_type) for the PNG bytes; or a failed event if generation, editing, or upload failed.
